headline: Up Your Arsenal carries 2,410 C functions from the US decompilation
summary: Up Your Arsenal's PAL v1.00 progress report now shows 49.25% matched code, with 3,598 of 4,903 entries reported finished. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. The day carries over 2,410 C functions from the US project across the loader, boot executable and front-end program.
highlights: The loader receives 42 C functions, the boot executable 1,476 and the front end 892.
Functions needing individual compiler flags, missing PAL symbols or producing different output remain outside the integrated C.
All three rebuilt programs are reported to match.
Beta-disc research documents shared code and debug material, with no beta contents committed.
